metadata.description: Mask indicating the subswath number associated with valid GCOV samples. A GCOV sample is only considered valid if it is generated from fully-focused radar samples. If at least one radar sample in the averaging set is partially focused or invalid, the corresponding mask pixel will contain the value 0. GCOV pixels outside of the radar acquisition extent are filled with the value 255

known_issue_observations.diagnostic_image: The 1st-to-99th percentile dB stretch shows terrain-scale texture and one compact bright cluster in both dates. It is a display stretch, not a classification.
known_issue_observations.extreme_tail: September 6 HHHH reaches 37714.5 at one pixel inside a bright neighbourhood that also contains one NoData sample. Fourteen September 6 HHHH pixels are at or above 10000, spread over rows 449-782 and columns 611-663.
known_issue_observations.official_context: Both scenes are provisional joint-mode 40 MHz products. The ASF guide says those products may retain residual radiometric bands, and provisional RFI filtering may leave interference or remove high-contrast features. This inspection does not assign a cause to the bright cluster.
known_issue_observations.row_and_column_mean_profiles: HHHH diagnostic dB row and column means vary by about 2.5 dB across the window. The largest adjacent step is about 0.53 dB. A strong periodic band is not evident in those profiles.
